source.title: How does Afterpay work? (Pay in 4)
source.notes: Quoted from the page: 'We split the total order amount into 4 instalments, taken automatically every 2 weeks.' 'The customer pays the first instalment at the time of purchase.' 'When paying in four installments, there is always 0% interest and never additional fees when they pay on time.' Confirmed on https://www.afterpay.com/en-US/how-it-works: 4 installments, first payment upfront, generally over six weeks, interest-free at partner brands.

notes: apr is a fraction and is 0.0 because the interest is 0% when paid on time. Late fees are not modeled. Neither page states a minimum or maximum order amount, and Afterpay says spending limits differ by shopper, so this file does not claim that any given refrigerator price qualifies. BnplTerms has no field for a limit; whoever shows the BNPL path should say the terms apply only when the shopper is approved for that amount.
